FX-LMAP-001.says: `card`, a plain drawing 5 by 3, in `holder`, a solid the size of the composition: centred at (1, 1), transparent round it.

FX-LMAP-002.says: `card_placed`, the same drawing moved, scaled 200 by 50, turned 30 degrees, at half opacity and Multiply: the same map as FX-LMAP-001, because nothing after step 3 counts.

FX-LMAP-003.says: `card_hidden`, switched off and used only as `holder`'s matte: the same map as FX-LMAP-001.

FX-LMAP-004.says: `card_masked`, its mask keeping columns 0 to 2: the map is cut the same way.

FX-LMAP-005.says: `card_bright`, with Exposure +1: the map is twice as bright.

FX-LMAP-006.says: `card_off_fx`, the same Exposure switched off: FX-LMAP-001's map.

FX-LMAP-007.says: `card_soft`, with Gaussian Blur sigma 0.5: blurred, and cut back to the card's own 5 by 3, so none of the blur's spread shows outside it.

FX-LMAP-008.says: `self` names itself: its drawing through its mask, and not its Exposure, fitted to its own 5 by 3.

FX-LMAP-009.says: `flip` shows the card on frame 0 and its second drawing from frame 1: the map follows the drawing exposed.

FX-LMAP-010.says: `flip_late` starts on frame 1: on frame 0 the map is empty, and nothing is said.

FX-LMAP-011.says: `flip_late` on frame 1 shows its first drawing, by its own timing.

FX-LMAP-012.says: `flip_ahead`, its source one frame ahead: on frame 0 it shows the second drawing.

FX-LMAP-014.says: `shape`, a box from (1, 1) to (5, 4): a shape layer's picture is the composition's size, so the map is the box where it is drawn.

FX-LMAP-015.says: `nest`, a composition layer: the inner composition's frame, 8 by 4, centred.

FX-LMAP-017.says: `nest` on frame 2, past the inner composition's two frames: empty, nothing said.

FX-LMAP-018.says: `nest_gone` shows a composition not in the project: empty, and `COMPOSITION_REFERENCE_MISSING`.

FX-LMAP-019.says: `rig`, a null, with tile: empty, nothing said.

FX-LMAP-020.says: `adjust`, an adjustment layer: white through its mask over columns 0 to 3, its Exposure not run.

FX-LMAP-021.says: `gone_file`, a drawing whose file is missing: empty, and `MEDIA_MISSING`.

FX-LMAP-022.says: Centre, `big` 10 by 8 into 8 by 6: dx = dy = -1, the middle shows.

FX-LMAP-023.says: Tile, `card` into 8 by 6: from (1, 1), repeating every 5 across and 3 down.

FX-LMAP-024.says: Tile, `big` into 8 by 6: a picture bigger than the holder tiles to FX-LMAP-022's centre.

FX-LMAP-025.says: Stretch, `card` into 8 by 6: bilinear, held at the card's edges.

FX-LMAP-027.says: Stretch, `card` into `holder_card`, a solid 5 by 3: the card exactly.

FX-LMAP-028.says: Centre, `card` into `holder_small`, 3 by 2: dx = -1 and dy = floor(-1/2) = -1.

FX-LMAP-030.says: Stretch, `card_masked` into 8 by 6: premultiplied, so the clear columns fade the covering and never tint the colour.

FX-LMAP-031.says: Draft, `stripes_fx`, a drawing with an effect, so its effects run at a quarter (D-99) on 2 by 2: `card_draft` is taken down to 2 by 1, its mask (0, 0)-(4, 3) becomes (0, 0)-(1, 0.75), then Exposure +1, then Gaussian Blur sigma 2 / 4.

FX-LMAP-032.says: Draft, `holder`, a solid, whose effects run at full size: FX-LMAP-001's map exactly.

FX-LMAP-033.says: Draft, `nest` holding: its picture is 2 by 1 at Draft. `nest_bright`'s inner frame is drawn at a quarter, then its Exposure.

FX-LMAP-034.says: Draft, `adjust` holding: its effects run on the 2 by 2 frame. `big` is taken down to 3 by 2 and stretched.

FX-LMAP-040.says: A name that is no layer: no map, and `EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING`.

FX-LMAP-041.says: `dot`, a layer of another composition: no map, and `EFFECT_LAYER_MISSING`.

FX-LMAP-042.says: An empty name: no map, nothing said.
